title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: Collaborative ★ Runaway!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios run together in the Takarazuka Kinen. They push each other on and both cross the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, we learn that Grandmother Mejiro actually is in the crowd. In contrast to Mejiro Palmer's visible agitation and embarrassment, she seems ever so slightly amused.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal is the autumn Tenno Sho. It's time to try again to see if she can run freely in a prestigious race.
